# Qt 6.11.2 third-party notices

These files retain the copyright and license text blocks published in Qt's
official versioned attribution pages. The collection covers every one of the
146 attribution pages linked by the Qt 6.11.2 third-party index and the Qt for
Python third-party license page. It is a conservative notice collection, not
a list of the libraries shipped by this application.

- Index: https://doc.qt.io/qt-6.11/licenses-used-in-qt.html
- Qt for Python: https://doc.qt.io/qtforpython-6.11/licenses.html
- Retrieval date: 2026-10-22
- Files: 147 UTF-8 notice texts, containing 323 upstream text blocks.

The copyright and license blocks are reproduced in source order. HTML markup
is removed, character references are decoded, and line endings use LF. Their
wording is unchanged. Each notice names its source page. `PROVENANCE.json`
records SHA-256 hashes for both the retrieved source HTML and the distributed
text, the number of blocks, and the file size. No images, fonts, example assets,
third-party source implementations, or binaries are in this directory.

Some attribution pages reproduce a short license notice which refers to a full
standard license. The collection also includes the full applicable standard
texts on other attribution pages, including Apache License 2.0 and Mozilla
Public License 2.0; the LGPLv3 and GPLv3 texts are in the parent directory.

The directory deliberately contains notices for unused Qt modules and examples.
Their presence does not add those components to the program. Check the actual
binary inventory when changing the build, and obtain updated notices and
matching source information before changing the pinned Qt version.
